=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:147-149 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The guard call in `_review_github_ai_grant_prepare` passes `--emit-automation-grant ... --origin-repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY:-}"` and runs inside the token-less `deps_prepare` step, so for a pipeline-authored linked issue with an origin reference `check_origin_chain` → `fetch_issue_with_gh` (scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py:323-342) runs `gh api` with no credentials, fails, and `build_automation_grant` (424-431) returns `origin_unverified`.
  WHY: The last run moved only the pipeline login lookup into the token-holding "Collect PR metadata" step, not the origin chain, so re-issues, fix-ups and follow-ups never get the review-path grant (`REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT phase=prepare outcome=none reason=origin_unverified`), and the editor's `.github/ai/<file>` write is refused as `unsafe_result_path`, while implement (holding GH_PAT) grants the same issue. The failure is closed, so there is no security impact. All three reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:119-131 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The login fallback reads `${REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PIPELINE_LOGIN:-}` and tests `-z`, but review_autofix.yml (line ~3927/3929, `|| ''`) always sets the variable. So when the metadata lookup failed or was skipped, the helper still spawns `timeout 30 gh api user` in token-less `deps_prepare` and logs `reason=no_credentials` instead of the real cause.
  WHY: The call can never succeed: it wastes a process spawn, up to 30 s worst case, and the misleading reason code points operators at the wrong step. It also contradicts the in-code comment ("no second call is made") and the agents.d text ("runs only when the variable is unset"). The grant outcome is unchanged (fails closed). Severities disagree: minimax rated it MAJOR, while sonnet, gemini and glm rated it NIT. The highest is used.
- tests/test_github_ai_plan_grant_write.py:`test_prepare_helper_fails_open_without_api_call` | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The no_credentials case sets `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PIPELINE_LOGIN=""` and asserts `reason=no_credentials`, but it does not assert `not (tmp_path / "gh_calls.txt").exists()`, so it passes even though `gh` is called.
  WHY: Without this assertion the `${VAR:-}` fallback bug can ship unnoticed. The earlier branches (`no_github_ai_path`, `linked_issues_incomplete`) already make that assertion.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:review / gate job, support-ref resolution step (run 44983292517, check-run/job 137088567624) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The only failed check aborts at support-ref resolution (`SUPPORT_REF source=promote_candidate_unprotected`, then `GH_API_RETRY outcome=gave_up ... status=403 ... endpoint=repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/main`, exit 75). The cause is environmental and maps to no hunk in this PR.
  WHY: The gate failed closed correctly, but the new `collect_pr_metadata` → `deps_prepare` login handoff was never validated in CI, so the gate needs a re-run after the rate-limit reset, not a code change. Severities disagree: sonnet rated it MAJOR (confidence 2) and glm rated it NIT (confidence 4). The highest is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: R3 review-editor half: "the review editor and the heal editor may create or edit" a `.github/ai/<file>` that the issue's trusted `files_touched` list names exactly, via the automation-path grant ("a trusted author or the pipeline login", running "the Q82 origin-chain check"). Also: "A `.github/ai/<file>` that the issue's trusted `files_touched` list names exactly can now be written by the pipeline."
  expected_change_site: scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh (the token-holding metadata step should pre-resolve the origin chain or emit the grant), or scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh `_review_github_ai_grant_prepare` (should consume a pre-resolved grant; guard call around lines 148-150), or the agents.d fragment (should acknowledge the limitation)
  confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The origin-chain fetch still runs in token-less `deps_prepare` (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh line 149) and no hunk moves it or skips it when no token is present. `test_prepare_helper_uses_the_precomputed_login_without_gh` uses an issue with no origin footer, so no test covers a pipeline-authored issue with an origin reference. The agents.d "Review." bullet covers the token half but not the origin-chain half, so pipeline-authored re-issues log `reason=origin_unverified` and the write is refused as `unsafe_result_path`.
- requirement: "Contract tests cover the new behaviour, the `_ENABLED=false` path and the defaults." (Phase 5 acceptance criterion)
  expected_change_site: tests/test_github_ai_plan_grant_write.py (the workflow-default-empty path, where `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PIPELINE_LOGIN` resolves to `''`)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: No case sets `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PIPELINE_LOGIN=""` and also asserts that `gh_calls.txt` is empty and that the expected reason (`no_credentials`/`identity_unavailable`) is logged. `test_prepare_helper_fails_open_without_api_call` omits the `gh_calls.txt` assertion. The companion fix is in scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:119-122 (`${VAR:-}` -> `${VAR+x}`).
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:lines 147-149 (also scripts/files_touched_scope_guard.py lines 1929-1930, 323-342, 424-431; review_autofix.yml lines 3916-3929, 2061) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The origin-chain lookup still runs in token-less `deps_prepare`. For a pipeline-authored issue matching ORIGIN_REFERENCE_PATTERNS (lines 154-162: `Re-issued from #N`, the unblock fix-up marker, `- Replaces: #N`, `- Source issue: #N`, `- Parent issue: #N`), `fetch_issue_with_gh` fails twice and returns None, so the reason is always `origin_unverified` and `paths` stays `[]`.
  WHY: Re-issues and fix-ups never get the review-path grant, and the `.github/ai/<file>` write is refused as `unsafe_result_path`, while implement grants it. This contradicts the agents.d text. It fails closed. Plain sub-issues (`Tracking issue: #N`) are unaffected. Suggested fix: pre-resolve the origin chain in review_collect_pr_metadata.sh, or document the limitation.
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:lines 120-128 (related: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml line 3929) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The variable is always set (empty on a failed or skipped lookup), so the empty-check fallback still runs `gh api user` in token-less `deps_prepare` and reports `no_credentials`. The in-code comment and agents.d/9920-github-ai-plan-grant-write.md describe behaviour the code does not have.
  WHY: The diagnostic is misleading and a doomed gh spawn is wasted. Suggested fix: use `[ -z "${REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PIPELINE_LOGIN+x}" ]` and log `identity_unavailable` when the variable is set but empty.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:review / gate job, support-ref resolution step (check-run 137088567624, run 44983292517) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The gate fails before any touched step: `SUPPORT_REF source=promote_candidate_unprotected`, then a 403 `GH_API_RETRY outcome=gave_up` on `repos/shubhodeep1/coding-workflows/branches/main`, exit 75. This is environmental.
  WHY: The new login handoff was not validated. The fail-closed behaviour is correct. Re-run after the rate-limit reset, and do not patch it in this PR.
- TASK_GAP | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  Requirement: R3 review editor half: "the review editor and the heal editor may create or edit" a `.github/ai/<file>` named exactly in trusted `files_touched`, via the automation-path grant ("a trusted author or the pipeline login", "the Q82 origin-chain check").
  Expected change site: scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh (resolve the origin chain or emit the grant) or scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh `_review_github_ai_grant_prepare` (consume a pre-resolved grant).
  Evidence of absence: The origin-chain fetch still runs in token-less `deps_prepare` (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh line 149), and no hunk moves it. No test covers a pipeline-authored issue with an origin reference (`test_prepare_helper_uses_the_precomputed_login_without_gh` uses no origin footer). The ci.yml entry is not a gap.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (3 related items), HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1:
  - scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:_review_github_ai_grant_prepare, lines 120-128: detect unset with `${REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PIPELINE_LOGIN+x}`, and log reason=identity_unavailable when the variable is set but empty (about 3 lines).
  - scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:line 149: pass `--origin-repo` only when GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN is non-empty, so it fails closed at once (about 3 lines).
  - scripts/review_collect_pr_metadata.sh:github_ai_grant_pipeline_login block: log `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT phase=collect outcome=none reason=identity_unavailable` to stderr on lookup failure (about 2 lines).
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:121-123 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_review_github_ai_grant_prepare` runs a `gh api user` fallback request even when REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PIPELINE_LOGIN is explicitly set but empty.
  WHY: This causes unnecessary network requests and possible log noise when the variable is already set (e.g. when the metadata step failed).

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:lines 119-122 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `${REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PIPELINE_LOGIN:-}` treats unset and empty the same, and review_autofix.yml line 3927 always sets the variable (`|| ''`), so the helper spawns `timeout 30 gh api user` in token-less `deps_prepare` and reports `reason=no_credentials`.
  WHY: Up to 30 s is wasted per review that does not output a login, the cause is misreported, and the in-code comment and the agents.d bullet are wrong. Fix: `${VAR:-}` → `${VAR+x}`.
- tests/test_github_ai_plan_grant_write.py:`test_prepare_helper_fails_open_without_api_call` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The test sets `REVIEW_GITHUB_AI_GRANT_PIPELINE_LOGIN=""` and asserts `reason=no_credentials`, but it does not assert that `gh` was not called (`gh_calls.txt`).
  WHY: The test passes even with the bug present. Add `assert not (tmp_path / "gh_calls.txt").exists()`, plus a workflow-default-empty case.

  Requirement: "Contract tests cover the new behaviour, the `_ENABLED=false` path and the defaults."
